content.title: Sky-Stage Solo Dance | Full-Body Rhythm, Close Wink and Pose Recovery
content.summary: An adult rooftop radio host performs one continuous eight-count phrase with a single wink peak. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult character, wardrobe and stage persist. + The body phrase remains continuous and countable. + The close-up preserves environmental and clothing anchors. + Only one wink marks the performance peak. + The final full-body stance returns to the opening center mark.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult animated radio host full-body on a circular rooftop stage under a clear blue sky. Move from full body to chest view without cutting; face, white RADIO DAY shirt and skyline remain registered. Pull back to full body, complete one left side step and finish with both feet planted at the opening center mark.
required_anchors: One clearly adult character, wardrobe and stage persist.
The body phrase remains continuous and countable.
Only one wink marks the performance peak.
The final full-body stance returns to the opening center mark.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult rooftop radio host performs one continuous eight-count phrase with a single wink peak. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一成年动漫舞者、白色文字 T 恤、宽腿裤和圆形天空舞台；全身步法与手臂动作连续推进，中段收紧到眨眼近脸，再回到全身完成最后一个抬膝与侧步。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult character, wardrobe and stage persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult character, wardrobe and stage persist."

invariants.rule: The body phrase remains continuous and countable.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The body phrase remains continuous and countable."

invariants.rule: The close-up preserves environmental and clothing anchors.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The close-up preserves environmental and clothing anchors."

invariants.rule: Only one wink marks the performance peak.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Only one wink marks the performance peak."

invariants.rule: The final full-body stance returns to the opening center mark.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final full-body stance returns to the opening center mark."
